result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority, the same order the sales rep's list uses. The region, sales-rep and support-ticket tests pass (RegionManagerTest 6/6, TicketsPerSalesRepTest 3/3, SupportTicketTest 5/5). Nothing is committed.

- **`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`** (around line 5277): `findOpenSupportTicketsOfCustomersInRegion` now calls `.highestPriorityFirst()`, the same option the sales-rep finder uses, and its Javadoc says so. This finder is used only by `RegionManagerService.overviewFor`, so no other caller changes.
- **`src/test/java/com/acme/backoffice/RegionManagerTest.java`** (new test after the first overview test): `openTicketsOfTheRegionAreListedHighestPriorityFirstThenOldestFirst` builds your example (T-1 to T-5 plus a closed high-priority ticket and an other-region ticket) and asserts the order T-3, T-5, T-2, T-4, T-1.
